Title: 1. The Exorcist
description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

Title: 2. The Sting
description: Two grifters team up to pull off the ultimate con.

Title: 3. American Graffiti
description: A group of teenagers in California's central valley spend one final night after their 1962 high school graduation cruising the strip with their buddies before they pursue their varying goals.

Title: 4. Papillon
description: A French convict in the 1930s befriends a fellow criminal as the two of them begin serving their sentence in the South American penal colony on Devil's Island, which inspires the man to plot his escape.

Title: 5. The Way We Were
description: During post-WWII McCarthyism, a diametrically opposed couple come together only to find out that genuine friendship and physical attraction is not enough to overcome fundamental societal beliefs.

Title: 6. Magnum Force
description: Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan pursues a conspiracy of vigilante cops, who are not above going beyond the law to kill San Francisco's undesirables.

Title: 7. Live and Let Die
description: James Bond is sent to stop a diabolically brilliant heroin magnate armed with a complex organization and a reliable tarot reader.

Title: 8. Serpico
description: An honest New York cop named Frank Serpico blows the whistle on rampant corruption in the force only to have his comrades turn against him.

Title: 9. Sleeper
description: A nerdish store owner is revived out of cryostasis into a future world to fight an oppressive government.

Title: 10. High Plains Drifter
description: A stranger makes townsfolk prepare garish welcome for convicts.

Title: 11. Battle for the Planet of the Apes
description: Ten years after a worldwide series of ape revolutions and a brutal nuclear war among humans, Caesar must protect survivors of both species from an insidious human cult and a militant ape faction alike.

Title: 12. The Day of the Dolphin
description: A marine biologist teaches his dolphins to communicate in English but shady characters plan to kidnap the trained mammals for a more sinister purpose.

Title: 13. The Wicker Man
description: A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

Title: 14. Amarcord
description: A series of comedic and nostalgic vignettes set in a 1930s Italian coastal town.

Title: 15. A Bigger Splash
description: Semi-fictionalized documentary biopic of British artist David Hockney. After a difficult break-up, Hockney is left unable to paint, much to the concern of his friends. Titled after Hockney's pop-art painting 'A Bigger Splash'.

Title: 16. The Holy Mountain
description: In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.

Title: 17. The Mother and the Whore
description: The chauvinist Alexandre balances relationships with several women in the post-1968 intellectual scene of Paris.

Title: 18. Mean Streets
description: In New York City's Little Italy, a devoutly Catholic mobster must reconcile his desire for power, his feelings for his epileptic girlfriend, and his devotion to his troublesome friend.

Title: 19. Enter the Dragon
description: A Shaolin monk travels to an island fortress to spy on an opium lord - who is also a former monk from his temple - under the guise of attending a martial arts tournament.

Title: 20. Ganja & Hess
description: After being stabbed with an ancient, germ-infested knife, a doctor's assistant finds himself with an insatiable desire for blood.

Title: 21. Wattstax
description: Documentary covering a Stax Records-sponsored all-day concert at the 1972 Watts Summer Festival with performances by Stax Records artists such as Isaac Hayes, Rufus Thomas, The Staples Singers, and more.

Title: 22. The Fate of Lee Khan
description: Lee Khan, a high official under Mongolian Emperor Yuan of the Yuan dynasty (year 1366) procures the battle map of the Chinese rebel Chu Yuan-Chang's army. Rebel spies, aided by treachery within Khan's ranks, strive to corner him in an inn.

Title: 23. Detroit 9000
description: After a fundraiser for a black politician is robbed, Detroit police put two detectives, one white and one black, on the case, who try to work together under boiling political pressure.

Title: 24. Day for Night
description: A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

Title: 25. The Long Goodbye
description: Marlowe investigates a friend's alleged suicide, missing money and murder in 1970s Los Angeles.

Title: 26. Badlands
description: An impressionable teenage girl from a dead-end town, and her older greaser boyfriend, embark on a killing spree in the South Dakota Badlands.

Title: 27. Robin Hood
description: The story of the legendary British outlaw portrayed with the characters as anthropomorphic animals.

Title: 28. Don't Look Now
description: A married couple grieving the recent death of their young daughter are in Venice when they encounter two elderly sisters with a warning from beyond.

Title: 29. Soylent Green
description: A nightmarish futuristic fantasy about the controlling power of big corporations and an innocent cop who stumbles on the truth.

Title: 30. The Friends of Eddie Coyle
description: After his last crime has him looking at a long prison sentence for repeat offenses, a low level Boston gangster decides to snitch on his friends to avoid jail time.

Title: 31. Westworld
description: A robot malfunction creates havoc and terror for unsuspecting vacationers at a futuristic, adult-themed amusement park.

Title: 32. Paper Moon
description: During the Great Depression, a con man finds himself saddled with a young girl who may or may not be his daughter, and the two forge an unlikely partnership.

Title: 33. The Last Detail
description: Two Navy petty officers are ordered to escort a young enlisted sailor to prison, but decide to treat him to a few entertaining diversions along the way.

Title: 34. The Day of the Jackal
description: In the aftermath of France allowing Algeria's independence, a group of resentful military veterans hire a professional assassin codenamed "Jackal" to kill President Charles de Gaulle.

Title: 35. The Spirit of the Beehive
description: In 1940, after watching and being traumatized by the movie Frankenstein (1931), a sensitive seven-year-old girl living in a small Spanish village drifts into her own fantasy world.

Title: 36. The Paper Chase
description: A first-year law student at Harvard Law School struggles with balancing his coursework and a woman, unaware that she has a connection that affects their relationship.

Title: 37. Fantastic Planet
description: On a faraway planet where blue giants rule, oppressed humanoids rebel against their machine-like leaders.

Title: 38. The Hourglass Sanatorium
description: Józef visits his dying father at a remote mental institution, where time itself doesn't seem to exist, and the line between dreams and memories becomes indistinguishable.

Title: 39. Lady Snowblood
description: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

Title: 40. Scarecrow
description: An ex-con drifter with a penchant for brawling is amused by a homeless ex-sailor, so they partner up as they head east together.

Title: 41. F for Fake
description: A documentary about fraud and fakery.

Title: 42. The Last of Sheila
description: A year after Sheila was killed by a hit-and-run driver, her wealthy husband invites a group of friends to spend a week on his yacht playing a scavenger hunt mystery game. The game turns out to be all too real and all too deadly.

Title: 43. The Three Musketeers
description: A young swordsman comes to Paris and faces villains, romance, adventure and intrigue with three Musketeer friends.

Title: 44. My Name Is Nobody
description: A young, easy-going gunman worships and competes with a famed gunfighter, insisting that he must face down a gang of 150 outlaws before he can retire.

Title: 45. The Legend of Hell House
description: A physicist, his wife and two mediums are hired to investigate the Belasco House, where 27 guests had inexplicably died in 1927, along with most of a team of paranormal investigators that was sent in the early 1950s.

Title: 46. Jesus Christ Superstar
description: Film version of the musical stage play, presenting the last few weeks of Christ's life told in an anachronistic manner.

Title: 47. Belladonna of Sadness
description: After being raped by an evil feudal lord and subsequently getting banished from her village, a peasant girl makes a pact with the Devil to gain magical powers and take her revenge.

Title: 48. Pat Garrett & Billy the Kid
description: Pat Garrett is hired as a lawman on behalf of a group of wealthy New Mexico cattle barons to bring down his old friend Billy the Kid.

Title: 49. Theater of Blood
description: A Shakespearean actor takes poetic revenge on the critics who denied him recognition.

Title: 50. The Big Feast
description: A group of men go to a villa in the French countryside where they resolve to eat themselves to death.

Title: 51. Charley Varrick
description: A man, his wife, and their friend stage a bloody bank robbery without realizing that they are stealing from the Mob.

Title: 52. The Outfit
description: Earl Macklin robs a bank owned by the mob, serves his prison time and is released, only to start a private war against the crime outfit that owned the bank.

Title: 53. Coffy
description: A nurse turns vigilante when her sister becomes the victim of drug dealers.

Title: 54. Malicious
description: A widower and two of his sons become infatuated with their beautiful housekeeper, and all three set out to seduce her using their own unique methods.

Title: 55. The Crazies
description: The military attempts to contain a man-made combat virus that causes death and permanent insanity in those infected, as it overtakes a small Pennsylvania town.

Title: 56. Immoral Tales
description: An anthology of several erotic-themed short stories.

Title: 57. Breezy
description: A young woman runs away from her staid home life and meets an irascible older man. After reluctantly allowing her to stay with him, the pair develop a romantic and affectionate relationship.

Title: 58. Turkish Delight
description: An aimless young artist learns to face his responsibilities when a former lover develops a terminal illness.

Title: 59. The Mad Adventures of Rabbi Jacob
description: A bigoted Frenchman finds himself forced to impersonate a popular rabbi while on the run from a group of assassins - and the police.

Title: 60. The Offence
description: A burnt-out British police detective finally snaps whilst interrogating a suspected child molester.

Title: 61. Torso
description: When the University of Perugia is rocked by a string of murders committed with red-and-black scarves, four co-eds retreat to a countryside villa where the killer is closer than they think.

Title: 62. Flesh for Frankenstein
description: Baron Frankenstein creates two "zombies" - one male, one female - planning to mate them in order to create a master race.

Title: 63. Ivan Vasilyevich Changes His Profession
description: An ordinary Soviet building manager, living in the 20th century, looks like Tsar of All Rus' - Ivan IV the Terrible (1530 - 1584). He'd never known this, until his neighbor created a time machine.

Title: 64. Emperor of the North
description: In 1933, during the Depression, Shack the brutal conductor of the number 19 train has a personal vendetta against the best train hopping hobo tramp in the Northwest, A No. 1.

Title: 65. Thriller: A Cruel Picture
description: A mute young woman undertakes training in firearms, martial-arts, and driving to wreak vengeance upon the swindlers who have forced her into prostitution and heroin addiction.

Title: 66. Three Wishes for Cinderella
description: Life changes dramatically for a Czech housemaid when the family coachman gives her three magical hazelnuts.

Title: 67. Save the Tiger
description: A melancholic, middle-aged businessman who co-owns a large garment manufacturer, which is in financial trouble, plans to commit insurance fraud to save his company, while reminiscing about his childhood, and having WWII flashbacks.

Title: 68. Sssssss
description: A college student becomes lab assistant to a scientist who is working on a serum that can transform humans into snakes.

Title: 69. Night Watch
description: A nervous woman is a witness to murder...but whose?

Title: 70. The Single Girls
description: A group of swingers at a Caribbean resort are stalked by a mysterious killer.

Title: 71. 14 and Under
description: A series of "sex reports" intended to address the issue of pedophilia in the early 1970s.

Title: 72. My Dear Brother
description: Two poor men try to find a television as a last wish for the terminally ill brother of one of them.

Title: 73. The Baby
description: A social worker, still reeling from the loss of her architect husband, investigates the eccentric, psychedelic Wadsworth Family, consisting of a mother, two daughters, and an adult son with the apparent mental capacity of an infant.

Title: 74. The Mack
description: A recently-released convict becomes the most powerful pimp in Oakland, but tragedy ensues when his activities draw the ire of two corrupt cops and the crime lord he once worked for.

Title: 75. Black Mama White Mama
description: A Black prostitute and a white revolutionary must form an uneasy alliance when they are busted out of prison, then pursued by guerrillas, bounty hunters and the Army.

Title: 76. Charlotte's Web
description: Wilbur is a farm pig who's terrified that he'll end up on the dinner table. His friend Charlotte, a charming spider, comes to his rescue. She weaves words into her web, convincing the farmer that Wilbur is too special a pig to kill.

Title: 77. The Vault of Horror
description: An anthology of five horror stories shared by five men trapped in the basement of an office building.

Title: 78. Bohachi Bushido: Code of the Forgotten Eight
description: A ronin Shino Asu (I die Tomorrow) gets rescued by the Bohachi clan. Their leader Shirobei Daimon, charged by the Shogun with running Edo's brothels enlists him to kill clients of tea-house whores who are stealing his business.

Title: 79. Lost Horizon
description: While escaping war-torn China, a group of Europeans crash in the Himalayas, where they are rescued and taken to the mysterious Valley of the Blue Moon, Shangri-La.

Title: 80. Le Magnifique
description: Writing his 43rd spy novel, François includes people from his life. He's the competent, sophisticated secret agent Bob in stark contrast to François. His cute neighbor is Tatiana who helps Bob in Acapulco.

Title: 81. The Creeping Flesh
description: A Victorian-age scientist returns to London with his paleontological bag-of-bones discovery from Papua New Guinea. Unfortunately, when exposed to water, flesh returns to the bones unleashing a malevolent being on the scientist's family and friends.

Title: 82. Black Caesar
description: Raised in Harlem, Tommy Gibbs becomes a successful mob boss but he clashes with the rival Mafia and his old enemy, dirty cop McKinney.

Title: 83. The MacKintosh Man
description: A member of British Intelligence assumes a fictitious criminal identity and allows himself to be caught, imprisoned, and freed in order to infiltrate a spy organization and expose a traitor.

Title: 84. Wonder Women
description: While looking into the disappearance of a jai alai athlete, an insurance investigator is targeted by the sexy, all-girl army of rogue transplant surgeon Dr. Tsu.

Title: 85. Secrets of Naked Girls
description: Ugo Domani has landed as a guest worker in Germany and works in municipal waste collection. As a constantly sharp-edged Papagallo, he is sexually constantly under power and craves for German women.

Title: 86. Return of the Evil Dead
description: A small Portuguese village prepares for a centennial festival when blind, execution-scarred Templar knights rise from their graves to hunt the living by sound.

Title: 87. Two Men in Town
description: A former bank robber is released after 10 years in prison. He gets help from a social-worker, but gets harassed by an old cop from his past.

Title: 88. The Erotic Rites of Frankenstein
description: Dr. Frankenstein and his assistant Morpho are killed just as they bring their creation to life. The monster is taken by Cagliostro and he now controls the monster and plans to have it mate and create the perfect master race.

Title: 89. Voices
description: A woman released from a mental hospital questions her sanity after she hears strange voices in the country manor she has moved into with her husband.

Title: 90. Schlock
description: A small town is terrorized by "The Banana Killer", which turns out to be the missing link between man and ape.

Title: 91. Tales That Witness Madness
description: A psychiatrist tells stories of four special cases to a colleague.

Title: 92. The Loreley's Grasp
description: The legendary Lorelei has been living for centuries in a grotto beneath the Rhine river in Germany. Every night when the moon is full, she turns into a reptile-like creature craving for human blood. When one girl after another of a nearby boarding school is killed by her, a hunter named Sirgurd is engaged to kill the monster.

Title: 93. Seduction
description: Giuseppe commits to love a woman he hasn't seen in 15 years, amid dangers of seduction from her daughter.

Title: 94. The Devil's Plaything
description: A lesbian vampire's soul is kept on in the bodies of her descendants.

Title: 95. The Train Robbers
description: A gunhand named Lane is hired by a widow, Mrs. Lowe, to find gold stolen by her husband so that she may return it and start fresh.

Title: 96. Invasion of the Bee Girls
description: A powerful cosmic force is turning Earth women into queen bees who kill men by wearing them out sexually.

Title: 97. The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad and the vizier of Marabia, followed by evil magician Koura, seek the three golden tablets that can gain them access to the ancient temple of the Oracle of All Knowledge.

Title: 98. Baba Yaga
description: A photographer finds herself falling under the spell of a witch.

Title: 99. The Cheerleaders
description: A group of cheerleaders from the local high school decide to show their school spirit for their football team by sleeping with the opponents the night before the game so that they can be so worn out the opposition won't be able to play.

Title: 100. The Satanic Rites of Dracula
description: Professor Lorrimer Van Helsing uncovers a conspiracy involving a modern satanic cult and a biological weapon, forcing a final confrontation with the ageless Count Dracula to prevent a global extinction event.

Title: 101. The Seven-Ups
description: Tough detective Buddy leads an elite New York City unit to convict felons and jail them for a minimum of seven years. Buddy is trying to find out who killed his partner but uncovers a plot to kidnap mobsters for money.

Title: 102. Cahill U.S. Marshal
description: A tough Marshal has a difficult task when his two sons join a gang and rob a bank.

Title: 103. The Stone Killer
description: A top New York detective is sent to Los Angeles where he must solve a case involving an old Sicilian Mafia family feud.

Title: 104. Bang the Drum Slowly
description: The story of the friendship between the New York Mammoths major-league baseball team's worldly-wise pitcher Henry "Author" Wiggen and half-wit catcher Bruce Pearson as they cope with Bruce's terminal illness during a baseball season.

Title: 105. Ludwig
description: The reign of the tormented Ludwig, king of Bavaria, from 1864 to 1886.

Title: 106. O Lucky Man!
description: An ambitious coffee salesman has a series of improbable and ironic adventures that seem designed to challenge his naive idealism.

Title: 107. Schoolgirl Hitchhikers
description: Two female hitch-hikers get mixed up with a gang of thieves and their stolen jewelry.

Title: 108. Godzilla vs. Megalon
description: An inventor creates a robot that is seized by an undersea kingdom to guide their monster god in attacking the surface as retaliation for the nuclear tests that have devastated their society.

Title: 109. Electra Glide in Blue
description: Desperate to be promoted to Homicide Detective, a motorcycle cop patrolling the Arizona highways investigates a suicide case, which he believes is murder, with a superior officer siding with him and helping him investigate.

Title: 110. Bell from Hell
description: After being falsely accused of being insane and put in an asylum so his wicked aunt and her daughters could steal his money, a recently released young man returns to seek the ultimate revenge against them.

Title: 111. Scorpio
description: During the Cold War, the CIA orders free-lance operative Scorpio to assassinate his former CIA mentor Cross and a deadly cat-and-mouse game ensues.

Title: 112. The Last House on Dead End Street
description: After being released from prison, a young gangster decides to punish society by making snuff films.

Title: 113. Story of a Cloistered Nun
description: Refusing an arranged marriage, young aristocrat Carmela is sent to a convent. Her arrival intensifies the power struggle between the debauched nun Elizabeth, and the stern but evil Mother Superior, as both are smitten by Carmela's beauty.

Title: 114. The Iron Rose
description: A young couple out for a walk decide to take a stroll through a large cemetery. As darkness begins to fall they realize they can't find their way out, and soon their fears begin to overtake them.

Title: 115. Don Juan, or If Don Juan Were a Woman
description: A modern-day Don Juan-styled woman, who prides herself in the destruction of men who have fallen for her charms, reveals to a priest the murder she has committed and honestly details her past sexual encounters.

Title: 116. The Spook Who Sat by the Door
description: A black man plays 'Uncle Tom' in order to gain access to CIA training, then uses that knowledge to plot a new American revolt.

Title: 117. The Hanging Woman
description: A man discovers the corpse of a young woman hanging in a cemetery.

Title: 118. The House That Vanished
description: A young model and her petty thief boyfriend find their way through the English fog to a backwoods manor in hopes of looting it. What they find instead is murder.

Title: 119. Hell Up in Harlem
description: A gangster in Harlem must rescue his ex-wife, who has been kidnapped by the Mafia.

Title: 120. Lemora: A Child's Tale of the Supernatural
description: A young girl who returns to her hometown to see her dying father finds herself being drawn into a web of vampirism and witchcraft.

Title: 121. The Death Wheelers
description: An amiable, psychopathic leader of a violent teen motorbike gang is spurred by his mother, a Satan-worshiping spiritual medium, into committing suicide and returning to life as an "undead".

Title: 122. Love & Anarchy
description: When a friend is murdered by the Facists, a melancholy farmer takes up residence in a Roman brothel as he and an anarchist prostitute plot to assassinate Mussolini.

Title: 123. The Corruption of Chris Miller
description: Abandoned by their husband/father, a traumatized woman and her disturbed stepdaughter hire a drifter handyman at their secluded estate while a series of murders begins.

Title: 124. The Reincarnation of Isabel
description: A group of vampires keep the body of a witch in a castle cellar. They require virgin blood to resurrect her. A party of people arrive and things kick off.

Title: 125. Horror Rises from the Tomb
description: A warlock's severed head is unearthed centuries after his execution. Reanimated, it seeks to reunite with its body, wreaking havoc as a group encounters its sinister quest.

Title: 126. Hangover
description: About a Saturday in Lasse and Lena's life.

Title: 127. A Delicate Balance
description: A well-to-do Connecticut family is upended when the grown daughter's godparents, seized by a nameless terror, decide to come live with them.

Title: 128. Cops and Robbers
description: Two disillusioned New York City policemen plan a ten million dollar robbery to fuel their low pensions, only to run into one debacle after another in the process.

Title: 129. Property Is No Longer a Theft
description: A neurotic Marxist bank teller quits his job and sets his sights on stealing everything - from tools to a mistress - from one of his former clients, a successful butcher.

Title: 130. The Witches Mountain
description: A photojournalist traveling through the Pyrenees on assignment with a beautiful writer stays overnight at an ancient Spanish castle and hears that the adjoining mountain is occupied by a coven of witches.

Title: 131. Golgo 13
description: Golgo 13 is assigned to murder a man named Boss Goa.

Title: 132. Santo and Blue Demon vs. Dracula and the Wolf Man
description: Después de ser derrotado por el mago Cristaldi, Drácula regresa para vengarse del Santo y Blue Demon contra Drácula y el Hombre Lobo. Con la ayuda del Hombre Lobo y sus seguidores, la victoria es inminente. Un descendiente del Mago Cistaldi es advertido de los planes de Drácula y pide ayuda a Santo y Blue Demon.

Title: 133. Ladies and Gentlemen: The Rolling Stones
description: A concert film taken from two Rolling Stones concerts during their 1972 North American tour.

Title: 134. Basanta Bilap
description: This film mainly consist of clashes between four boys and some girls of the hostel namely 'Basanta Bilap'. Both the parties uses hilarious tricks upon one another but evidently the three boys of the group falls in love with three girls of Basanta Bilap and the story goes on. At last the leaded of the boys group 'Shyam' falls for the girls group leader 'Anuradha' , and the story ends.

Title: 135. Anita
description: A troubled teen girl who impulsively seduces every man she meets has a chance encounter with an empathetic psychology student who attempts to help her explore her sexuality more healthily.

Title: 136. Godspell
description: An adaption of the musical, in a modern-day song-and-dance recreation of the Gospel of St. Matthew.

Title: 137. Superchick
description: Tara B. True is a flight attendant who makes a weekly swing through New York, Miami, and Los Angeles. In each city, she has a man: Edward, older and wealthy; Johnny, a beach bum with gambling debts; and, Davey, a rock musician on the cusp of success. Tara is a free spirit, faithful to each man in her own way, and so stunning that she dresses in a wig and ill-fitting uniform while she's working so men won't harass her constantly. The low-life whom Johnny is in debt to figures out a way to use Tara to help him execute a daring in-flight robbery. But will Tara stand by helplessly, or is superchick ready for action?

Title: 138. Sex Thief
description: An inspector and an insurance investigator both have a major stake in revealing the identity of an audacious jewel thief.

Title: 139. Sex & Fury
description: During the Meiji era, a gambler named Ochô takes revenge on the three dignitaries who killed her father, shelters a wanted anarchist, and crosses paths with a British femme fatale.

Title: 140. Terminal Island
description: After the abolishment of the death penalty, California murderers are dumped on an island to spend the rest of their lives unsupervised. There, two groups are formed, one lead by a psychopath, and another group determined to bring him down.

Title: 141. Walking Tall
description: Based on the life of Tennessee sheriff Buford Pusser, who almost single-handedly cleaned up his small town of crime and corruption, but at a personal cost of his family life and nearly his own life.

Title: 142. She Devils of the SS
description: In the last days of WW2, women are volunteering from all over Germany to serve in the front lines by having sex with Nazi soldiers.

Title: 143. Heavy Traffic
description: An underground cartoonist contends with life in the inner city, where various unsavory characters serve as inspiration for his art.

Title: 144. Lolly-Madonna XXX
description: In the early 1970s, a young woman passing through rural Tennessee unintentionally gets caught in a feud between two local neighboring clans, the Feathers and the Gutshalls.

Title: 145. Prijela k nám pout
description: Children from the village Bystrá are awaiting a nice and thrilling weekend. On Saturday they will play the championship football match with the nonresident boys from the village Skuhrov, on Sunday there will be the funfair with merry-go-round, swings and stalls with dainties. The members of the family of the merry-go-round man are brother and sister Janek and Zaneta Mareks whom the children have known since the last year. At that time Zaneta made friends with girls and Janek, an excellent football player, has been a welcome support of the football club.

Title: 146. Tiffany Jones
description: Light-hearted and occasionally unclothed adaptation of a British comic strip in the over-the-top, on-beyond-Bond spy fantasy vein.

Title: 147. The Iceman Cometh
description: A salesman with a sudden passion for reform has an idea to sell to his barfly buddies: throw away your pipe dreams. The drunkards, living in a flophouse above a saloon, resent the idea.

Title: 148. Female Vampire
description: A beautiful female vampire lures men to their doom.

Title: 149. Pets
description: A troubled young woman escapes her abusive brother accepting the kindness of strangers. Exploited, she perseveres thanks to growing street-smarts hoping that her next encounter will be with someone with a pureness of heart equal to her own

Title: 150. Sugar Cookies
description: After an actress is murdered by a pornographer during an erotic "game" that is made to look like a suicide, her lesbian lover uses another aspiring starlet as a pawn to exact revenge.

Title: 151. Executive Action
description: Rogue intelligence agents, right-wing politicians, greedy capitalists, and free-lance assassins plot and carry out the JFK assassination.

Title: 152. White Lightning
description: A prisoner is released from custody on the condition that he becomes a stool pigeon for the FBI to help them incriminate a corrupt sheriff.

Title: 153. The Bloodstained Lawn
description: Nina Genovese welcomes stranded outsiders into her remote villa, where generous hospitality conceals a dangerous operation, while a curious drifter and her companion begin noticing what the household is hiding.

Title: 154. Schoolgirl Report Part 5: What All Parents Should Know
description: Six more first-hand accounts of sexual awakening amongst school girls in the early Seventies - some with a happy end, some without.

Title: 155. Cries of Ecstasy, Blows of Death
description: Year 2062, the land is barren, post-apocalyptic vision of hell on earth. Environmental pollution, human callousness and evil. Marauding gangs of motorcyclists, violence and rape.

Title: 156. The Neptune Factor
description: When an underwater ocean lab is lost in a earthquake, an advanced submarine is sent down to find it and encounters terrible danger.

Title: 157. A Virgin Among the Living Dead
description: Following the death of her father, a young girl visits her estranged family at their sinister castle in the countryside, and comes to realize her eccentric and morbid relatives are not quite alive.

Title: 158. The Castle of Purity
description: The story of a disciplined, sexually-driven man who keeps his family isolated in their home for years to protect them from the "evil nature" of human beings while inventing rat poison with his wife.

Title: 159. Aesthetics of a Bullet
description: A low-life crook gets a job as a yakuza hit-man and proceeds to pretend to be a big shot. There are, however, things that cannot be faked.

Title: 160. And Now the Screaming Starts!
description: England, 1795: the young Catherine has just married Charles Fengriffen and moves into his castle. She becomes the victim of a curse that was laid on the family long ago. On her wedding night she is raped by a ghost and gets pregnant.

Title: 161. The Nun and the Devil
description: During the 1570s, in the convent of Sant'Arcangelo di Baiano, after the death of the mother superior, a power struggle rages on, as one nun, who comes from a powerful family, is willing to do anything to become the new abbess.

Title: 162. Cannibal Girls
description: A young couple spend the night in an old farmhouse owned by a reverend, only to find out that it is also lived in by beautiful women who hunger after human flesh.

Title: 163. Eugenie de Sade
description: After a bashful young woman discovers that her famed wordsmith stepfather is a psychopathic deviant, she becomes an accomplice in his murderous sex games.

Title: 164. Lisa and the Devil
description: A tourist spends the night in a derelict Spanish villa seemingly held in the supernatural grip of an eccentric butler, who resembles a depiction of the Devil she had seen on an old fresco.

Title: 165. The Final Programme

description: As brothers Claus and Mikkel inherit a farm with their cousin, it becomes the beginning of many new challenges. The cousins at Torndal are equally distinctive, naive and cheerful. The housekeeper Signe struggles to keep them on track, but behind the scenes a cunning estate inspector lurks.

Title: 313. The Deadly Trackers
description: A Sheriff, who negotiates with bank robbers, ends up having his family killed during their escape. The Sheriff chases the gang into Mexico on his own. While attempting to exact his vengeance, he is at odds with a Mexican lawman.

Title: 314. The Hireling
description: A young British woman suffering from depression over the loss of her husband develops an unusual relationship with her chauffeur.

Title: 315. Auch Ninotschka zieht ihr Höschen aus
description: A Russian official and his three female coworkers are mistaken for a pimp and his three prostitutes.

Title: 316. The Bamboo House of Dolls
description: A nurse in a Japanese women's POW camp during World War II masterminds an escapee.

Title: 317. Horror Hospital
description: Jason Jones and Judy Peters, young British people, meet on a train heading to the country. They stay with odd characters in a secluded mansion, where deranged Dr. Christian Storm is using his guests for surgical mind-control experiments.

Title: 318. Vengeance of the Zombies
description: An Indian mystic uses magical chants to raise women from the dead, then sends them out to perform revenge killings for him.

Title: 319. Penny Gold
description: While investigating a murder case, a detective stumbles upon a rare-stamp swindle involving the victim's twin sister.

Title: 320. Shock Treatment
description: A French businesswoman goes to a remote and popular rejuvenation clinic after a breakup, and begins to suspect the treatment methods used by the head doctor, and slowly uncovers the horrible secret behind the clinic's success.

Title: 321. The Adventures of Mowgli
description: A boy raised by animals learns to live by the laws of the jungle. Full-length version of the Soviet animated series.

Title: 322. Saudagar
description: A calculative man schemes to deceit a poor but young widow for his personal monetary gains.

Title: 323. Peg Leg, Musket & Sabre
description: A peg legged pirate is searching for treasure with the help of a young boy, teen girl and a parrot. They'll have to fight Natives and his former crew on the way.

Title: 324. The Nelson Affair
description: Young George Matcham visits his uncle Lord Nelson and the vulgar Lady Hamilton. With the clear eyes of youth, he measures Nelson's stature and notes his feet of clay. And yet, Nelson is a hero, a great man. How can this be resolved? Meanwhile, the combined French and Spanish fleet puts to sea.

Title: 325. Hit!
description: A Federal Agent, whose daughter dies of a heroin overdose, is determined to destroy the drug ring that supplied her. He recruits various people whose lives have been torn apart by the drug trade and trains them. Then they all leave for France to track down and destroy the ring.

Title: 326. Superdad
description: A father tries to help his daughter meet better friends, only to find his meddling backfires after he finds out that his daughter's friends are the best thing for her.

Title: 327. Blood Orgy of the She-Devils
description: Lorraine and Mark enter the world of witchcraft where Mara foretells the future and helps them remember their past lives. When a series of mysterious murders begin to occur, they turn to Dr. Helsford for advice.

Title: 328. A Doll's House
description: Based on Ibsen's play. A sheltered wife risks her career to hide a secret from her controlling husband. When a blackmailer threatens her facade, she is forced to confront the hollow reality of her marriage and her own suppressed identity.

Title: 329. Murder in a Blue World
description: A nurse tries to bring her own style of relief to miserable people, or ones condemned to die. Her identity is a mystery, and she may not be quite what she seems.

Title: 330. Lady Ice
description: An insurance investigator romances a wealthy young beauty when he suspects she may be involved in fencing stolen jewels.

Title: 331. Now Where Did the Seventh Company Get to?
description: Three French army scouts escape capture and go behind enemy lines during WWII, urged by a lieutenant to fight rather than hide.

Title: 332. Night of Fear
description: Insane sadistic hermit stalks and captures those who get lost in his part of the woods. A young woman whose car broke down is about to find out what he does with them next.

Title: 333. The Thief Who Came to Dinner
description: A computer programmer decides to become a thief. And when he starts making waves an insurance investigator hounds him. He also meets a woman who becomes his accomplice.

Title: 334. Badge 373
description: Grizzled racist cop Eddie Ryan is suspended from the force after a suspect falls off a roof while escaping arrest. Then Eddie's partner Gigi Caputo turns up dead in Brooklyn with his throat cut. Eddie vows to clean up the streets.

Title: 335. Redneck
description: Sadism and sleaze dominate this fast-paced film about the getaway aftermath of a heist-gone-wrong-turned-kidnapping.

Title: 336. Female Prisoner Scorpion: Beast Stable
description: Matsu is sheltered by an incestuous prostitute on her run from the police, her ex-prison mate and a cop whose arm she hacked off.

Title: 337. Three Giant Men
description: A crime wave is terrorizing Istanbul, and the police call in American superhero Captain America and Mexican wrestler Santo to end it.

Title: 338. The Naked Ape
description: In a series of live action and animated vignettes, the evolution of humanity is depicted and explored, primarily through the experiences of Cathy, a tour guide in a natural history museum, and Lee, a college student infatuated with her.

Title: 339. Horror High
description: A shock-filled tale of a serious and shy but brilliant science student who, when wrongfully forced to consume a new drug he'd created, becomes a modern day Jekyll and Hyde.

Title: 340. The House of 72 Tenants
description: A group of poor tenants, crowded together in a tenement slum, suffer constant abuse from their nasty landlady and her sleazy husband, who try to exploit their tenants in whatever way they see fit.

Title: 341. Hot Pepper
description: Follows Zydeco legend Clifton Chenier, New Orleans' self-proclaimed "King of Zydeco." Features interviews with Chenier, family and friends, local scenery, edited by Les Blank.

Title: 342. And When She Was Bad...
description: A divorced man welcomes his former stepdaughter into his home, where she now lives with him and his girlfriend. Her sweet appearance masks dark desires and violent tendencies that threaten their peaceful lives.

Title: 343. A Slightly Pregnant Man
description: When a male driving school owner goes to see his doctor with complaints of feeling run down, he is pronounced four months pregnant. When the diagnosis is confirmed by a specialist, the result is an international media frenzy.

Title: 344. The Black Alley Cats
description: Wanting revenge on a street gang for a rape attack, four young girls get together, take kung-fu lessons, learn how to shoot, form a gang called the Black Alley Cats and search out the gang that attacked them.

Title: 345. I Like the Girls Who Do
description: To get an inheritance from his uncle, a young man must make love to seven women in 7 days. He goes through so much to get the inheritance in this typical farce.

Title: 346. Orgy American Style
description: The voluptuous and sultry foxy owner of a pirate radio station manages to stay always one step ahead from the Police who constantly tries to put her hot show-on-wheels out of business for good.

Title: 347. The Student Teachers
description: Sexy student teachers at Valley High School give private lessons while being terrorized by a mad rapist.

Title: 348. Teen-Age Jail Bait
description: Stranded when their car gets a flat tire, two sexy girls accept help from two hippies in a dune buggy. After sex to repay the favor, the four team up for a robbery at one of the girl's home, but it goes terribly wrong.

Title: 349. Class of '44
description: The "terrible trio" of "Summer of '42" has graduated high school. Now the real learning begins. For Benjy, 1944 is a time to serve his country.

Title: 350. Défense de savoir
description: When the police find Simone seated near her husband's corpse it is predictable that she is charged with the murder. Jean-Pierre Laubray is appointed counsel for the defence. He begins an inquiry into the case and he finds out that the murdered man had killed a barman in a robbery the night before. He finds out as well he was a leg-man of Cristiani's for his election campaign. He tries to contact Juliette, Cristiani's daughter, and he discovers that also Bruno, Juliette's brother, died that same night in a car accident...

Title: 351. Huracán Ramírez y la monjita negra
description: The film is part of a series of films centered on the Mexican masked wrestler character, Hurricane Ramirez , which began with Hurricane Ramirez (1952). Had only appeared in the early films starring El Santo .

Title: 352. Steelyard Blues
description: Several misfits decide to restore a PBY flying boat and fly to a place where they can enjoy total freedom but a few obstacles hamper their plans.

Title: 353. The Young Nurses
description: Sexy young nurses apply special therapy in their daily rounds, as they work against a drug ring operating out of the hospital.

Title: 354. Digby: The Biggest Dog in the World
description: Digby consumes a bowl of a liquid growth formula called Project X. Soon he becomes a sheepdog of gigantic size.

Title: 355. Manson
description: Documentary on Charles Manson and his family. Has a number of insightful interviews with many family members most notably Squeaky and Sandy (Blue and Red). There is also a history of Manson from his birth to the family formation to the Tate/La Bianca murders. Plenty of footage of the family playing at Spahn Ranch.

Title: 356. Love and Pain and the Whole Damn Thing
description: Teenage Walter abandons cycling tour, joins Lila's bus tour in Spain. They develop romance, travel together. Relationship tested during extended stay with Spanish nobility.

Title: 357. The Big Store
description: Four guys working for a small grocer in trouble, declare war on a new giant neighborhood supermarket by attempting several coups. A film about the big store taking over the business of smaller stores.

Title: 358. White Fang
description: The wolf dog, White Fang, aids a reporter, a fur trapper, a nun, a young Eskimo boy and his father of ridding a gold mining town of a sleazy crime lord in 1896 Yukon, Canada.

Title: 359. The Black 6
description: A high school student, who is a person of colour, is caught dating a white girl by the girl's brother. He and his biker gang beat the boy to death. The boy's brother seeks revenge.

Title: 360. The House in Nightmare Park
description: In 1907, an actor is invited to perform in an isolated country house, and becomes involved in mysterious and dangerous events.

Title: 361. La notte dell'ultimo giorno
description: A film director wants to make a politically charged movie, but is hampered by his producer. At the same time, a friend of his commits suicide, and he goes insane.

Title: 362. From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler
description: Precocious Claudia and her brother run away from home and hide in the Metropolitan Museum in New York.

Title: 363. Urlaubsgrüße aus dem Unterhöschen
description: The story takes place in the fictional Bavarian village of Hirnkirchen and describes a series of amorous erring and confusion.

Title: 364. Some Too Quiet Gentlemen
description: A dying village attempts to revive itself but ends up hosting disruptive hippies. When a local is murdered, tensions spike until both sides unite to catch the killer and discover mutual respect.

Title: 365. The Mad Bomber
description: Los Angeles detectives Minelli and Blake must track down a serial rapist who may know the identity of a mentally disturbed bomber.

Title: 366. Namak Haraam
description: Somnath (Somu) lives in a shanty house in a Delhi slum with his widowed mom, and unmarried sister, Sarla. He is friendly with Calcutta-based wealthy Vikram (Vicky) Maharaj. When Vicky's dad, Damodar, has a heart attack and is advised to take bed-rest for two months, Vicky fills in his father's shoes, has a confrontation with a senior employee and union leader, Bipinlal Pandey, which results in a strike. His father intervenes, asks Vicky to apologize to Bipinlal, which Vicky does, and everything returns to normal. Vicky confides about his humiliation with Somu, and both conspire to teach Bipinlal a lesson. As a result, Somu accompanies Vicky to Calcutta, gets a job as a laborer in his mill, befriends his fellow-workers, gets some monetary relief to injured workers, amongst other benefits, is elected as the union leader replacing Bipinlal. With Somu as the union leader and Vicky as the boss there is no stopping these two - until Damodar finds out and decides to put a stop to Vicky being influenced by Somu's middle-class ideas and ideals. Damodar starts a chain of events that get out of control, events that may well see the death of one of the friends at the hands of the other. Will Vicky's and Somu's friendship see them through or will it also be a casualty?

Title: 367. Please Don't Eat My Mother!
description: A middle-aged man buys a plant with a sexy voice that develops a craving for insects, frogs, dogs, and humans.

Title: 368. Bust Out
description: The Browns take their Catholic high school students on a picnic. As one student sneaks to her boyfriend, two others seduce escaped convicts who rape the fourth. Mrs. Brown and her husband fall victims to their prudence.

Title: 369. The Sinful Bed
description: An antique bed relates passionate stories about various people who have made love on it throughout the decades of the 20th century. Said folks include a sweet young virgin, a sly prostitute who helps a jilted woman get revenge on her unfaithful husband, a German soldier fighting in World War II who's on leave for two hours, and a carefree modern couple.

Title: 370. A Scream in the Streets
description: Two Los Angeles detectives are assigned to track down and arrest a brutal rapist-murderer terrorizing the city. Their job is complicated by the fact that the killer is able to avoid capture because he can pose as a woman.

Title: 371. The Roommates
description: Heather, Beth, Carla, Brea, and Heather's cousin Paula are five lovely young ladies who decide to spend their summer vacation at Lake Arrowhead. While at Lake Arrowhead the women hit the party circuit and get involved with various men in the area. However, things go awry when the gals find themselves the targets of a mysterious murderer.

Title: 372. Daag: A Poem of Love
description: Sunil is convicted of murder and is on the run. But the long arm of the law and his past finally catch up with him. Can he outrun his destiny for long?

Title: 373. The Knock Out Cop
description: Adventures of the police inspector "Flatfoot" Rizzo in the slums of Naples.

Title: 374. Supergirl
description: A magic ring from the goddess of the sea transforms a pure-hearted country lass into a superheroine. She must save her town from a female mad scientist, a kaiju frog, and a zombie outbreak.

Title: 375. Giovannona Long-Thigh
description: A new judge closes a cheese factory for pollution; its owner, La Noce, bribes a monsignor who points him toward an official who might fix it. La Noce needs leverage and discovers the official's taste for other men's wives. He sends his stuttering assistant, Albertini, to hire a willing woman to pretend to be La Noce's wife. Albertini finds a virginal-looking prostitute with a potty mouth. A train trip from Rome to Sicily has many mix ups, but once in Sicily, maybe La Noce's plan to compromise the official will succeed. All the characters converge: La Noce, his wife, Albertini, the whore, her pimp, the official, his wife, and the official's jealous secretary. What about the cheese?

Title: 376. Wesele
description: Set at the turn of the century, the story concerns a Polish poet living in Cracow who has decided to marry a peasant girl. The wedding is attended by a heterogenous group of people from all strata of Polish society, who dance, get drunk and lament Poland's 100-year-long division of Poland under Russia, Prussia, and Austria. The bridegroom, a painter friend, and a journalist each in turn is confronted with spectres of Polish past. In the end a call to arms is called but turns out to be a hoax.

Title: 377. The Burned Barns
description: The body of a young woman is found near a farm. Judge Larcher suspects farmers Rose and Pierre are linked to the murder.

Title: 378. Jeremy
description: Shy cellist boy meets upperclassman ballet-student girl at school. They experience first-time love, then happenstance pulls them apart.

Title: 379. Visions of Eight
description: Eight film artists from different countries are given carte blanche to make a collection of short documentaries on the 1972 Munich Summer Olympics, offering unexpected, original and often humorous perspectives.

Title: 380. Some Call It Loving
description: A woman who's been asleep for years is part of a carnival that sells her kisses for a buck. A lonely jazz musician buys her. Once awake, the two of them and his two girlfriends hook up. But sometimes, dreams are better than reality.

Title: 381. The Don Is Dead
description: After his mistress is savagely beaten up a Mafia leader goes after the killer with a bloody vengeance. Soon after the hunt begins, a gang war ensues.

Title: 382. Summer Wishes, Winter Dreams
description: Rita, a middle aged New York City homemaker, finds herself in an emotional crisis which forces her to re-examine her life, as well as her relationships with her mother, her eye doctor husband, her alienated daughter and estranged son.

Title: 383. Charley and the Angel
description: Charley is a workaholic family man who finds out from an angel that his "number's up" and he will be dying soon, so he tries to change his ways and be a better husband and father with the time he has left.

Title: 384. The Naughty Stewardesses
description: Sexy air stewardesses - four naughty female flight attendants - become involved with a wealthy womanizer, with unsurprising results. They live out their wildest sexual softcore nude fantasies.

Title: 385. Abhimaan
description: A popular singer convinces his new wife to enter show-business, but his pride is wounded when she outshines him.

Title: 386. Terror Circus
description: Three showgirls on their way to Las Vegas have stuck all night when their car breaks down. The next morning ,a man offers them help, but, he's really a maniac.

Title: 387. Woods Are Wet: Woman Hell
description: Sachiko has just committed a crime. She is helped by a couple to whom she grants her confidence. Quickly this couple blackmails her and threatens to deliver her to the police. Sachiko has no other choice but to obey them.

Title: 388. Female Prisoner Scorpion: #701's Grudge Song
description: Once again on the lam, Matsu is helped by a strip club worker who holds a grudge against the detective who's trying to find her.

Title: 389. Checkmate
description: The Federation's Boss must call their best agent out of a bedroom romp with a gentleman because the USA, Russia, Britain and France, the four nuclear powers, are under the menace of an atomic weapon carried by their very own super secret joint satellite. An unnamed power, represented by the sexy and intelligent Madame Chang, by various means (sexy hit-girls and some violence) has been retrieving the keys to the computer that controls that weapon from the only men in the world who had got those precious keys... The beautiful and daring Diana Burns, after being driven over New York by helicopter, is forced to play a double game with the British agent to save his life, to fight a Dark hit-girl in Central Park, and try to avoid paying the 4 billion dollar ransom demanded by the Eastern gang. Pepper will have to use her other attributes, to uncover treachery among her own people and to play two deadly games of chess to win the day. The world will be safe again, and then pepper can rest again - or at least go to bed.

Title: 390. The Violent Professionals
description: When his colleague is murdered by an organised criminal gang, a Milanese cop goes undercover to continue the investigation and single-handedly destroy the organization from within.

Title: 391. Wicked, Wicked
description: Someone murders and dismembers a series of blonde women; unique in that it is shot entirely in the early 1970's cinema gimmick DUO-VISION (split screen).

Title: 392. Giordano Bruno
description: Fleeing enemies in the Catholic Church, free-thinking philosopher, poet and scientist Giordano Bruno seeks refuge in Venice. However, the Roman Inquisition, fearing his influence, pursues him on charges of heresy.

Title: 393. No Sex Please - We're British
description: A mistaken address causes a newlywed couple's apartment to fill up with mail-order Swiss porn... right before a visit by the wife's father, a bank president who happens to be the husband's new employer. From the Broadway play.

Title: 394. The Legend of Paul and Paula
description: Paul and Paula have had bad experiences with love: Paul is financially well off but has lost all affection for his wife, and Paula leads a troublesome life raising two children on her own. They meet and discover a strong passion for each other. Life seems like a dream when they're together - but their short flights from the burdens of reality are once and again interrupted by Paul's ties to family and career.

Title: 395. The Homecoming
description: In a dreary North London flat, the site of perpetual psychological warfare, a philosophy professor visits his family after a nine-year absence, and introduces the four men, father, uncle, and two brothers, to his wife.

Title: 396. Happy New Year
description: Released from prison apparently under a New Year amnesty, a criminal tries to pick up the threads of a life changed not only by his daring plan to rob a jewelry store in out-of-season Cannes, but also by a very special someone he met there.

Title: 397. Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart in the Land of Demons
description: Five warriors challenge Ogami to duels. Each holds a part of information needed to complete the assassination of a mad clan leader.

Title: 398. The Flying Classroom
description: A group of boys from a boarding school in Bamberg face a multitude of challenges - fights against local school boys, conflicts with their prefect and overcoming their own fears.

Title: 399. Hostess in Heat
description: A window-cleaner in Zürich tells his extra-ordinary exploits to a film producer, with some segments about hostesses and a wood-fairy cobbled in.

Title: 400. I Will Walk Like a Crazy Horse
description: Running away from the police, Aden goes to the desert where he meets an uncivilized man who has a special link with Mother-Earth. He ends up by convincing the hermit to come along with him into another desert... the big town!

Title: 401. Ash Wednesday
description: After getting plastic surgery in Switzerland to help rejuvenate her shaky marriage, Barbara Sawyer has an affair with a younger man while waiting for her husband's arrival from the U.S.

Title: 402. Jory
description: Jory is a fifteen-year-old boy who joins a horse-drive after his father is killed by a drunkard. The drive's leader and a likable cowhand take the boy under their wing, and find that tragedy has taught him how to take care of himself.

Title: 403. Mark of the Devil Part II
description: A tribunal interrogates, tortures and murders "witches" and "heretics" during the Inquisition.

Title: 405. Blume in Love
description: The lawyer Stephen Blume, who specializes in divorces, is living a paradoxical situation where, having broken up his marriage, is still in love with his ex-girlfriend.

Title: 406. Oklahoma Crude
description: In 1913, in Oklahoma, oil derrick owner Lena Doyle (Faye Dunaway), aided by her father (Sir John Mills) and a hobo (George C. Scott), is stubbornly drilling for oil despite the pressure from major oil companies to sell her land.

Title: 407. Daddy
description: A fantasy about a woman's attempts to exorcise the influence of her sexually domineering father.

Title: 408. The Olsen Gang Runs Amok
description: Nobody picks Egon Olsen up after 8 months in prison. Benny and Kjeld now work at a grocery store. Egon decides to steal the DKK6,000,000+ from a criminal's safe alone, before the cops raid the place.

Title: 409. I Escaped from Devil's Island
description: In 1916, A group of prisoners plot their escape from the notorious fortress located in French Guiana.

Title: 410. The Mysterious Island of Captain Nemo
description: Escaped prisoners land their hot air balloon on remote islands. They face survival challenges while meeting a castaway, pirates and Captain Nemo, who uses tech to guard his island.

Title: 411. The Lonely Woman
description: Based on José Antonio García Blázquez's novel of the same name, the film tells the story of Jacinto Martín del Río, AKA 'Jaci', a fatherless lad who feels a strong love almost unhealthy for his mother, a bourgeois widow with unclear virtues. Anyway, that will not be an obstacle for him to notice other women.

Title: 412. Malatesta's Carnival of Blood
description: A family infiltrates a sinister carnival where their son mysteriously disappeared.

Title: 413. Anna and the Wolves
description: A British governess comes to an isolated house in Spain to take care of the children of a twisted and convoluted family.

Title: 414. Les zozos
description: The romantic adventures of two teenagers in the 60s, boarding at a provincial college.

Title: 415. When Love Is Lust
description: Emilia, product of a cloistered education and an aristocratic lineage is thrown into the arms of a brash parvenu, who she marries but refuses to consummate her marriage.

Title: 416. Baxter!
description: A young American boy unable to overcome a speech defect is disturbed by the constant bickering of his parents, and when they get divorced, he slides into an emotional breakdown.

Title: 417. Rugantino
description: Rome, 1800. Rugantino is a fool in love that rages eternal, though he is very unlucky in love stories and fruitful occasions.

Title: 418. Submersion of Japan
description: The shorted re-edited American version of Submersion of Japan, in which Japan slowly sinks into the sea as the US and Japan work together to stop it.

Title: 419. Fongaluli
description: A professor obsessed with crossbreeding animals of different species discovers a plant called Fongaluli which turns his lobster into a beautiful woman. He searches more leaves and encounters a horny female giant and a merry incest family.

Title: 420. Love Thy Neighbour
description: Two men who are next-door neighbors constantly battle over seemingly-trivial offenses; on the other hand, their wives are the best of friends. The two couples attempt to win a 'love-thy-neighbor' competition by lying.

Title: 421. The Oval Portrait
description: A woman finds herself possessed by the soul of another woman trapped inside a painting.

Title: 422. Slaughter's Big Rip-Off
description: Vigilante Slaughter comes under attack from Duncan, a local money launderer whose hit-man traps Slaughter in a car at a cliff, but Slaughter escapes, arms himself, and goes after Duncan's hideout.

Title: 423. Veronica
description: The movie " Veronica ", a masterpiece of Romanian cinema in 1973 with actors like Dem Radulescu, Lulu Mihaescu and Margareta Paslaru is today a charming film for children. In a magical world made with dream scenery, always put husbands and exuberant energy, Veronica, a girl who grows up in a home for children, receives a birthday present from her fairy godmother, played by Margareta Paslaru a magic bag that will fulfill any desire. Veronica refuses to share this gift with other children and for this is punished by Zana. From this moment the dream adventures of Veronica become very exciting. New characters appear as Puss Danila, played by Dem Radulescu, goody fox (Vasilica Tastaman), cricket, played by Florian Pitis and mouse in which we can see the role of George Michael. Elisabeta Bostan, iconic film director and writer of Romanian children waited for two years for permission to start the movie, filming in 1972 by launching a villa situated in the Prahova Valley, in ruins but gave Giulio Tincu life, high designer of his time.

Title: 424. The Dragon Strikes Back
description: A Chinese immigrant, recently arrived in America, fights to free Mexican slaves from their cruel master.

Title: 425. Laß jucken Kumpel 2. Teil: Das Bullenkloster
426. The Filthiest Show in Town
description: The heads of the National Genital Television Network go on trial to defend their network over one of their highest-rated shows: the very adult and very popular "Mating Game."

Title: 427. The Killer Is One of 13
description: A widow invites thirteen guests to stay at her rural mansion. She reveals to them that she suspects whoever killed her husband must be one of them. Soon, they too are being murdered one by one.

Title: 428. Drop Out
description: Billie drops out of college, and goes hitch-hiking. Soon, her beauty gets her a place in a lecherous tourist's car, whose next stop is a roadside hotel managed by a neo-nazi and his wife. Next morning, abandoned alone, and with no money to pay the hotel bill, Billie has to find several degrading ways to earn a living. With so many people eager for sex (a lesbian stripper, a photographer, a porn film director and his two nubile stars...)

Title: 429. The Lovers!
description: Big-screen version of the TV sit-com about the ups-and-downs of a young courting couple's relationship.

Title: 430. Welcome to Arrow Beach
description: A hippie girl wandering on a California beach is taken in by a Korean War veteran who lives in a nearby mansion with his sister. The girl soon begins to suspect that the mansion is home to some very strange goings-on.

Title: 431. Sans sommation
description: A discredited police inspector is given a second chance, in the form of a dangerous assignment. Chosen because of his uncanny resemblance to a Lt. Revere, the inspector impersonates him in order to penetrate a jungle camp belonging to a soldier of fortune friendly with Revere. He is then to assassinate Revere's friend.

Title: 432. Holiday on the Buses
description: After being fired from the bus company for crashing two buses, Stan and Jack seek bus-driving work at a holiday camp - only to find that Inspector Blake too now works there.

Title: 433. The Inconsolable Widow Thanks All Those Who Consoled Her
description: After the death of rich husband Salvatore in a car accident, his beautiful wife Caterina is preparing to collect the enormous legacy, but she will be able to benefit from it only if she gives birth to a child.

Title: 434. Through and Through
description: A struggling illustrator and his wife, disliked by his family, drift between jobs before attempting mail fraud. Their scheme leads to the murder of their elderly, disabled landlords.

Title: 435. Dhund
description: A traveler decides to assist a woman involved in a murder.

Title: 436. The Severed Arm
description: Trapped in a cave, five men cut the arm off of another companion in order to ward off starvation. After they are saved, their victim seeks revenge on them one by one.

Title: 437. Teenage Tramp
description: Rebellious runaway Kim flees her dangerous associates and travels to the West Coast to see her anxious, estranged sister Hilary and claim their parents' inheritance. However, drug dealer Maury and his gang pursue her there.

Title: 438. The Inheritor
description: A heir of media empire investigates who the enemy of his family is.

Title: 439. A River Called Titas
description: After their wedding night, a fisherman's young wife is kidnapped on the Titas River in Brahmanbaria, Bangladesh.

Title: 440. Psyched by the 4D Witch
description: Novice witch Cindy is transported into a world of safe sex by the voice of Abigail from the 17th century.

Title: 441. Emil och griseknoen
description: Emil visit a country auction, help Lina pull out a tooth and raise his pig to do tricks.

Title: 442. Feng liu yun shi
description: Tang Dynasty emperors, Ming Dynasty scholars, assorted fortunetellers, and several Buddhist monks figure in a trio of erotic and mystical Chinese legends.

Title: 443. Hanzo the Razor: The Snare
description: During the currency devaluation by the Edo treasury, officer Hanzo deals with a temple priestess who sells her pupils as prostitutes, and a notorious thief who plans to rob the mint.

Title: 444. Kamouraska
description: Quebec, the 1830s and 1840s. As she attends the bedside of Jérôme, her second husband, Élisabeth recalls her youth, her marriage to her first husband, Antoine, life in remote Kamouraska where he is seigneur, their love dissolving in his mental illness and cruelties, her falling in love with an American physician, Georges Nelson, and the aftermath of Antoine's violent death.

Title: 445. Hex
description: A group of friends who were World War I flyers ride their motorcycles across America in search of what they believe their generation lost during the war.

Title: 446. Not Now Darling
description: A philandering politician tries to arrange a tryst with his mistress, only to be constantly thwarted by his wife, a bumbling friend, and a series of chaotic misunderstandings at a London hotel.

Title: 447. Girls Are for Loving
description: Ginger is back, more daring than before as she takes you through heart pounding scenes of violence and gripping lust. Ginger's hard hitting display of martial arts could be performed by nobody more beautiful.

Title: 448. Teresa the Thief
description: Teresa Numa in Nardecchia, motherless daughter of a heartless Lazio peasant, becomes a war widow and single mother constantly looking for new jobs--and often forced to steal in order to live.

Title: 449. A Warm December
description: An African-American doctor falls in love with the niece of an African ambassador during his vacation in London, but it turns out that she is suffering from a rare terminal illness.

Title: 450. The Optimists
description: A retired entertainer makes his living as a street musician on the streets of London. Two young children befriend the old musician, brightening his otherwise colorless life.

Title: 451. Apaches
description: Directed by Gottfried Kolditz, this action-packed Eurowestern is based loosely on the legend of heroic Apache warrior Ulzana.

Title: 452. Fe, esperanza y caridad
description: The movie consists of three separate segments, each dealing with faith, hope, and charity.

Title: 453. Love Bavarian Style
description: Vittorio pretends to be gay so he can chaperone a rich man's daughter on vacation in Germany. Unfortunately his driver really is gay and Vittorio has a problem.

Title: 454. That Man Bolt
description: To take a briefcase from Hong Kong to Mexico City, via Los Angeles, is it necessary to call on that man - Bolt? With the number of dangerous spies and gangsters who are after that briefcase, maybe Jefferson Bolt is not enough.

Title: 455. Malachi's Cove
description: A tough young girl lives with her aging grandfather near a cove on the coast of Cornwall. She supports herself and him by gathering seaweed to sell as fertilizer. A cocky young neighboring boy decides to help her with the work.

Title: 456. The Invitation
description: After his mother's death, a middle-aged insurance clerk inherits a city cottage, sells it for a fortune, and buys a country house, where a drunken garden party exposes his colleagues' hidden frustrations and true selves.

Title: 457. La yegua colorada
description: Valeriano Mendoza (Narciso Busquets) se adueÃ±a a la mala de la Hacienda Las Maravillas, propiedad del padre de Adolfo Contreras (Antonio Aguilar) lo cual propiciarÃ¡ su caÃ­da y perdiciÃ³n cuando todo se juegue en una sola carrera.

Title: 458. The All-American Girl
description: Debbie's boyfriend Bobby has left for Guatemala for three months and Debbie is expecting a boring summer. But then she hasn't considered her neighbors and their 15-year old son Johnny.

Title: 459. Girl Without a Name
description: A writer rescues a young woman lying injured on the road. She awakens with amnesia, but insists that she is the writer's wife. Is she the victim or the perpetrator of a devious plot?

Title: 460. Facets of Love
description: A brothel, which was founded during the Ming Dynasty, steams with tales of imperial erotic myths, trysts and twists of pleasurable indulgence, and sometimes violent nature.

Title: 461. Heterosexualis
description: In this soft core comedy Virgil has a sexual dysfunction and gets help from the fellow residents in his hotel to try and fix it.

Title: 462. The Mandolin
description: Gallows is being raised in a prison yard. A moment before the execution the Girl brings a document of the young communist's temporary pardon. The chief of the prison, the Major, has a mandolin collection. He offers a fistfight to the young communist. The young man hits him. The Major and the young communist start playing the mandolins together. Girl is allowed to meet the young communist. The boy begins to play. The melody brings to the Major pleasant memories. He fought in the Spanish civil war, but after the defeat, he turned back on his beliefs. The Major receives a telegram that he needs to send the young communist to another prison. Death awaits him there. In is rage the Major breaks the mandolins. He orders the young communist to be taken out to work. The young man runs off. The Major shoots him himself.

Title: 463. The National Health
description: A comedy lampooning Britain's National Health System through a dilapidated London hospital's eccentric staff and patients. Features "Nurse Norton's Affair," a parody of TV medical soap operas.

Title: 465. Godmonster of Indian Flats
description: A mutant sheep is on the move near a ranch in the American West.

Title: 466. Love Brides of the Blood Mummy
description: A revived mummy needs the blood of young women to slake his thirst.

Title: 467. Adolf Hitler: My Part in His Downfall
description: In 1940 London, jazz musician Spike Milligan joins the Royal Artillery at Bexhill for war training. He and his fellow soldiers experience both humorous and serious situations during their service.

Title: 468. The Wild Little Bunch
description: "The 14" or "Existance" has a mother of 14 children living in poor working class England falling sick and the children try to carry on as a family. Convincing acting from young actors raises this gritty tale above the horizon.

Title: 469. The Scarlet Letter
description: In 17th-century Salem, Hester Prynne must wear a scarlet A because she is an adulteress with an out-of-wedlock daughter whose father she has refused to name for seven years. A vigorous older stranger arrives, but he's not a stranger to Hester; he is her long-estranged husband. He poses as Dr. Chillingworth, watching Hester and searching out her lover's identity. His eye soon rests on Dimmesdale, an overwrought young pastor. Enmity grows between the two men; Chillingworth applies psychological pressure and the pastor begins to crack. A ship stops in Salem, and Hester sees it as a providential refuge for her daughter, herself, and her lover. Will Dimmesdale flee with her?

Title: 470. Sensuela
description: A Lappish girl, the only daughter of a reindeer herder, rescues a crashed German fighter pilot during WW2. The two develop warm feelings for each other during his convalescence.

Title: 471. The Mermaid
description: After listening to an old man tell a story of his marriage to a real life mermaid, some sailors decide to see if they can find mermaid brides of their own.

Title: 472. Jheel Ke Us Paar
description: Kulwant Rai's horse carriage runs over a child, and as a result, she loses her vision. Years later she grows up to be beautiful girl namely, Neelu (Mumtaz), and Kulwant Rai's son, Sameer (Dharmendra) takes a fancy to her. This fancy turns to love, and he proposes to marry her. This proposal does not auger well with his mother, Rani Maa Rai (Veena), who wants her son to marry Jugnu (Yogeeta Bali), who is the daughter of her Diwan (Iftekhar), and both Rani Maa and Jugnu pressure and humiliate Neelu so that she can leave Sameer. Sameer's attempts to get Neelu her vision take root when he meets with eye specialist Dr. J.P. Tandon (Shatrughan Sinha). When Jugnu finds out about this, she concocts a devious plan that will get Neelu out of her way forever.

Title: 473. Warlock Moon
description: A college girl meets a reporter, they take a trip to the country, and they wind up meeting a creepy old woman who lives in a closed-down resort.

Title: 474. Two People
description: Evan Bonner is an army deserter who returns home to deal with the fallout of his actions. He becomes distracted when he meets attractive model Diedre McCluskey, thinking he's fallen in love.

Title: 475. When Taekwondo Strikes
description: During the Japanese occupation of Korea, the leader of a resistance movement, who's also a Taekwondo master, and his apprentices struggle against the brutal Japanese occupiers, aided by a Chinese female martial artist.

Title: 476. Never Mind the Quality: Feel the Width
description: The trials and tribulations of a tailor-shop partnership owned by a Jewish man and an Irish Catholic man.

Title: 477. Story of a Love Story
description: A married writer with a blurred perception of fantasy and reality and a woman whose husband is aware of her infidelities embark on a passionate affair - or do they?

Title: 478. Terrifying Girls' High School: Lynch Law Classroom
description: Three new students at a super strict girls' school face off against the oppressive administration, a corrupt politician and a sadistic student discipline brigade.

Title: 479. Don Quijote cabalga de nuevo
description: Don Quixote is obsessed with knighthood and its honor codes. Together with his singular squire Sancho Panza, Don Quixote remembers the adventures they have shared.

Title: 480. Not Scared to Die
description: Historical movie, set during the Japanese occupation of China during WWII, in which a group of Chinese rebels tries to oust the Japanese forces from a small town. Jackie Chan is one of the good guys but has nothing much more than a supporting role.

Title: 481. Big Zapper
description: A female private detective, Harriet Zapper, is hired by a rich old man to find his missing children, and becomes involved in counterfeiting and murder

Title: 482. Bummer
description: A touring small-time rock band called The Group picks up a couple of groupies. One night, the band's drunken, hulking bass player goes nuts and rapes the girls. The band refuses to believe that he's trouble, which leads to more tragedy.

Title: 483. L'emigrante
description: At the end of 1900s Saturnino Cavallo leaves his family to emigrate to America, in search of fortune.

Title: 484. El niño es nuestro
description: Arturo, Paloma and their friends now face a struggle with their parents over their baby. When Paloma's father sends the baby to an orphanage, leaving them no choice but to make a daring raid on the orphanage to get their child back.

Title: 485. Gordon's War
description: Four Vietnam Vets go to war against the drug dealers and pimps of Harlem.

Title: 486. Fun and Games
description: A middle aged suburban couple find a copy of Screw Magazine and get turned in by the photos. They place an ad in the swinging couples column and attend a S & M party before realizing that this new life is not for them.

Title: 487. Charley-One-Eye
description: A black, Union Army deserter and his crippled American Indian hostage form a strained partnership in the interests of surviving the advancing threats of a racist bounty hunter and neighboring bandits.

Title: 488. My Wife, a Body to Love
description: The story of a nymphomaniac model with a somewhat older businessman husband. Although he is aware of his wife's many, many infidelities, it is unclear for a LONG time whether he is actually jealous of them or turned on

Title: 489. Chinese Hercules
description: A martial arts fighter, haunted by his past, takes a job as a dock worker in a small village. His vow never to fight again is tested by the cruel owner of the pier.

Title: 490. Paperback Hero
description: A hockey player in a small town begins to lose his grip on reality, and starts to believe that he is a gunslinger in the Old West.

Title: 491. The Best Pair of Legs in the Business
description: With his life crumbling around him in a dingy holiday camp, middle-aged female impersonator Sherry Sheridan stays rooted in the past. But will his son Alan, and long-suffering wife Mary, stay with him?

Title: 492. Wide Open Marriage
description: What attractive German housewives do when their career-minded husbands leave the house for a long day at the office.

Title: 493. Joshila
description: Jailor Manmohan Krishan is responsible for looking after convicts undergoing sentences of rigorous imprisonment. He has a young, beautiful and captive daughter named Shalini. Shalini is a poet, one day while reciting her poetry, she meets with a young man, who introduces himself as Amar, who also happens to be a poet himself. The two of them spend beautiful moments together and finds themselves attracted to each other. Shalini wants to find out why Amar is in jail. She is told in no uncertain terms that Amar is in jail for murder - for killing the brother of his former lover, Sapna. She also found out that this is not true and would strive to the best of her merit to get Amar release from jail because she is in love with him and would like to marry him.

Title: 494. Mean Frank and Crazy Tony
